text_block_list.text:
While Symboli Rudolf trained with 
unmatched focus, Narita Brian came to 
report a problem.

Not wishing to be a burden to the esteemed 
President, the Umamusume handling general 
affairs spoke up and submitted her 
resignation.

Symboli Rudolf devises a plan, inviting 
them to come watch the Satsuki Sho 
together.
